messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-3.2.2 released and on pypi
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

rpy2-3.2.2 is released an on pypi. The only additional fixes compared to
3.2.1 are better handle of failures of failure to build or install (now it
tells why it fails).

L.
